name: Clear the Threshold
summary: Step into the Sunken Crypt and defeat 4 Crypt Gnashers.
startText: Crypt Gnashers have overrun the upper halls. Clear four of them and report back.
inProgressText: Four Crypt Gnashers in the Sunken Crypt — step through the northern archway to find them.
completionText: Clean work. Take this coin and restock at Lyra's Apothecary.
